routes.name: Varzia relics, as Nami Skyla Prime
routes.cost: 1 Aya a relic during her Prime Resurgence, 2 Rare Blades, 12-hour build

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 1 per relic; bank it before the window opens

groups.activity: buy the Nami Skyla Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Nami Skyla Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

rows.label: Nami Skyla Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blade relics: every one carries it as the Rare, and the build needs 2

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

groups.activity: crack the Nami Skyla Prime relics

rows.label: Nami Skyla Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith Z2 or Meso C3 or Neo A6 or Axi L2 or Axi L3 or Axi V7, Common: 25.33% Intact; Neo N25, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

rows.label: Nami Skyla Prime Handle
rows.note: Lith C2 or Lith H1 or Meso D3 or Meso S7 or Neo H3, Uncommon: 20% Radiant; Neo H5, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Nami Skyla Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith N9 or Neo N8 or Neo N10 or Axi N5 or Axi N14, Rare: 10% Radiant

conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Common relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
